create_InputConfig: create an InputConfig with support_images flag and num_tokens_per_image for multimodal input setup
create_Input_text_only: create an Input object with text tokens and no images for text-only model inference
create_Input_with_images: create an Input object with text tokens containing image placeholders and image tensors for multimodal inference
test_Input_properties: test the Input object properties like batch_size, max_num_images, length_with_mm, tokens_with_mm, and attention_mask
run_Input_pad: run the pad method on an Input object to extend sequence length with padding tokens
